summary: Reviewed the art-characters module after the previous build. Re-ran tests and the filtered typecheck, and re-read the three existing gallery screenshots. Made one fix: the default bunny colourway was white fur with a pale lilac outline (#9a86bd) on a white background, so it was low contrast. The fur is now #f3efff with a darker outline (#6b5a9c). The other open issues are not fixed. The screenshot tool cannot run on this macOS machine, so the bunny change is not visually re-captured. The user's three messages contained only image coordinate multipliers with no text, so I did not act on them.
publicApi: Unchanged from the previous report: Character, CompanionArt, LumiHorn, POSES, CHARACTER_IDS, COLORWAYS, normalizeColorway, Colorway, ACCESSORY_IDS, accessorySlot, isAccessoryId, AccessoryId, AccessorySlot.
tests: npx vitest run src/art/characters src/art/companions: 3 files, 588 tests passed (after the bunny edit). npm run typecheck filtered to src/art/(characters|companions): 0 lines of errors.
openIssues: Visual review is still incomplete. The pose sheets and the full species x colourway sheet have not been captured or judged. The bunny fix is unverified visually.
The unicorn horn overlaps the wizard-hat and beanie in the accessory grid. This is a drawing issue in species/unicorn.tsx or the accessory anchors and was not changed.
tools/shot.mjs hardcodes /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome, which fails on macOS. It belongs to whoever owns tools/. Fixing it needs an env override or a macOS path.

The screenshots in /Users/mac13/Desktop/Inessa-Mat/shots/ (art-chars.png, art-companions.png, art-acc.png, plus audio-ipad.png, which is not from this module) are untracked. Delete them or gitignore shots/ before commit.
The user's messages containing only image coordinate multipliers (three in this run) are unclear. Ask the user what they want pointed out.
notesForOtherModules: tools/shot.mjs needs a macOS-compatible Chromium path or an env override before screenshots work on this machine.
